About the Mental Health Promotion event

Mental Health Promotion is a Emergency Preparedness event in the HOSA secondary division. Format: speech & presentation · online submission.

Ten in-depth lessons for the HOSA Mental Health Promotion team event, following the 2026–27 guidelines: a pre-judged peer social media campaign built on youth risk and protective factors with a Mental Health Consultant (115 points) and a five-minute verbal presentation (105 points). Built around the Surgeon General’s advisory on youth mental health, SAMHSA, the Jed Foundation, Be There and the 988 Lifeline, with risk-and-protective-factor sorting, safe-messaging checks, post-building and timeline drills, upload checklists and presentation scenarios. This course teaches prevention and help-seeking; it is not a substitute for professional care. If you or someone you know is struggling, call or text 988.
